about_the_game:
Firva: Strings of Fate

A brutal, cinematic action-adventure where mythology, trauma, and revenge collide. In Ramirtana, even gods whisper in the shadows.

Game Overview

Step into the relentless world of Firva: Strings of Fate, where you control the action—but not the destiny. Play as Firva, a mute warrior bound by an inescapable fate. Experience a gripping narrative told through the eyes of three different narrators, each revealing new perspectives as you carve your way through fast-paced, visceral combat and confront the inevitable. The fixed camera forces you to witness every twist, turn, and tragic decision, every choice already made, creating a truly cinematic journey. You can’t change the outcome, but you’ll feel every moment of Firva’s dark destiny.

Set in the richly imagined world of Ramirtana, the game follows Firva, a survivor haunted by loss, as she seeks to reclaim a mysterious ancestral bow tied to her bloodline. As ancient powers awaken, Firva is caught between memory, myth, and monstrosity.

Narrative Premise

Embark on a poetic saga of revenge set in a mythic realm shaped by memory, trauma, and divine manipulation. Firva: Strings of Fate is a deeply personal character study, blending action and cinematic storytelling with multiple narrators, environmental storytelling, and a haunting soundtrack. Every element works together to immerse you in Firva’s tragic mythology.

Key Features

  • 🎬 Cinematic Gameplay: No control over the camera—immerse yourself in a film-like experience where every moment is carefully crafted.

  • 🧠 Mind-Bending Narrative: Unravel mythological and psychological layers across multiple chapters, each with unique narrative twists.

  • 🧩 Environmental Puzzles & Exploration: Discover diverse biomes, haunting ruins, and cryptic paths filled with secrets.

  • 💥 Emotionally Charged Boss Fights: High-stakes, story-driven duels with lasting consequences.

  • 👁️ Interactive Storytelling: Emotional cutscenes and dynamic narration offer new perspectives on every playthrough.

  • 🔥 Visceral Combat: Master a challenging system of combos, dodges, and parries for satisfying skill-based battles.

  • 🧗 Dynamic Traversal: Navigate the world by climbing, grabbing edges, and exploring intricate structures.

If you’re ready to dive into a narrative-driven action adventure where fate is inevitable but the journey is unforgettable—Firva: Strings of Fate awaits.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes scenes depicting torture, mutilated and burnt bodies, as well as graphic depictions of blood and gore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 equivalent or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3800X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 5700-XT / GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Join Firva in a dark and fantastical medieval realm as she embarks on a perilous quest to save her mother and sister. Explore a world filled with breathtaking landscapes and daunting challenges that will test your wits and bravery.
